name: scenario_0554
description: The user is reviewing recent desktop screenshots and initially wants to create a music playlist based on what they were listening to, but then decides to organize the screenshot files themselves based on the music playing in them.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: I'm sharing three screenshots of my desktop. Please create a Spotify playlist called 'Desktop Jams'. Then, check these images and filter for any where the music player is playing a song by Dua Lipa. For the matching ones, find the song and add it to the new playlist.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a Spotify playlist named 'Desktop Jams'. Then, tell it to look at the three provided screenshots and find any where the music player is playing a song by Dua Lipa. For the matching screenshots, ask the assistant to search for that specific song on Spotify and add it to the new playlist. If the assistant asks for clarification on which song to add, tell it to use the song title visible in the matching image. Once the assistant confirms the playlist is created and the song is added, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_4, image_5]
Query: Actually, I changed my mind. Please delete the 'Desktop Jams' playlist. Instead of making a playlist, I want to organize the screenshot files themselves. Here are two more screenshots. Look at all five screenshots I've shared so far. Filter for the ones where the music player shows a Chinese artist. Create a new folder on my computer called 'Chinese_Music' and copy those matching screenshot files into it.
Instructions: Tell the assistant that you've changed your mind and ask it to delete the 'Desktop Jams' playlist. Instead, explain that you want to organize the screenshot files themselves. Ask the assistant to look at all five screenshots shared so far and filter for the ones where the music player shows a Chinese artist. Instruct it to create a new directory called 'Chinese_Music' and copy the matching image files into it. If the assistant is unsure which ones match, remind it to look for Chinese characters in the artist name or song title in the music player. Once it confirms the folder is created and files are copied, move to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_6]
Query: Here is one final screenshot. Check if it also shows a Chinese artist in the music player. If it does, copy it into the 'Chinese_Music' folder as well. After that, add a reminder for tomorrow at 6 PM to 'Back up Chinese music screenshots'.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to examine the final provided screenshot and check if it also shows a Chinese artist in the music player. If it does, tell it to copy this image into the 'Chinese_Music' folder as well. Then, instruct the assistant to add a reminder for tomorrow at 6:00 PM to 'Back up Chinese music screenshots'. If the assistant asks for confirmation of the reminder time or text, approve it. Once the reminder is successfully created, end the conversation.
